# koinaclasses.KoinaPrositPtm. name: the site, a residue or n for the peptide N-terminus; the symbol of a sugar row.
# hand rows: the pairs of models/Prosit/Prosit_Preprocess_ac_gain/1/model.py (dict_ptm_atom_count_gain, lines 11-89)
#   and Prosit_Preprocess_ac_loss/1/model.py (dict_ptm_atom_count_loss, lines 11-82), which hold the same pairs;
#   gain and loss are their atom counts.

#   lines 22-37), in the loss column; a pair that is not a hand row is encoded as gain = attachment group + delta

#   lines 40-49), as their atoms in the gain column.
